Standing relaxed ready stance close to the source, a gentle three-quarter front turn toward screen-right, knees slightly bent, full silhouette readable. Keep the black jacket and trousers distinct against transparency through controlled edge lighting. Match the reference proportions and outfit; do not make him futuristic, armored, shirtless, heavily muscular, or give him a trenchcoat. Reference 2 controls ONLY the hand-painted arcade character-art style: crisp careful outlines, detailed shaded cloth, realistic adult proportions, controlled highlights. Do not copy Isaac's identity, cap, brown jacket, shotgun, posture or clothing. Preserve the entire subject from hat feather through both black shoes within a tall portrait canvas with generous transparent margins on every edge. No scene, floor, shadow oval, glow background, title, text, UI, label, collage, sheet or second figure. Rikiya is a lean adult Japanese man with a long sharply angular face, pronounced cheekbones and a stern concentrated expression, medium tan skin and messy black neck-length hair visible beneath a dark slate-blue fedora. Keep the short brim, indented crown, black hatband and one small brown feather at the side of the hat. His outfit is the dark slate-blue matching suit shown in reference 1: long single-breasted jacket with plain lapels, black collared shirt, vivid red necktie and small red breast-pocket triangle, slightly loose straight/flared trousers, black simple low-heeled shoes, and muted olive cuffs. No extra badges, armor, necklaces, belt ornaments, holsters or suit patterns. Keep the standing pose close to the complete source model: gentle three-quarter front view, feet apart, anatomical right arm lowered at viewer-left with the very long-barreled silver-and-dark handgun pointed down, greenish/dark grip details as seen in the source. The anatomical left arm at viewer-right is raised loosely, with index and little finger extended, middle and ring fingers folded and thumb visible; exactly one ordinary five-finger hand with no fused or duplicate fingers. Make the handgun one coherent handheld pistol with its barrel fully visible and no attached rifle stock. Retain the recognizable hat, shaggy hair, red tie and slate-blue suit palette rather than copying his shirtless default or his black leather variant. Single static wardrobe adaptation, no new identity or animation.
